A reporter writes a fictitious column about a man named John Doe, who claims to despair at America's neglect of the little people and plans to kill himself. To maintain the ruse, the newspaper hires a ballplayer-turned-hobo to pose as John Doe.
programme.title: Meet John Doe

programme.desc: Two Wild West con men (John Astin, Steve Carlson) ride into a Colorado town, unaware it sits on a fortune in ore.
programme.title: The Brothers O'Toole

programme.desc: A carefree singing priest (Bing Crosby) clashes with a no-nonsense nun (Ingrid Bergman) at a school in a struggling parish.
programme.title: The Bells of St. Mary's

programme.desc: A waitress (Brooke Shields) leads an old drunk (Burgess Meredith), a diver and a young man (Tom Byrd) with a yacht to sunken Bahamas treasure.
programme.title: Wet Gold

programme.desc: Two sailors (Frank Sinatra, Gene Kelly) on leave in Hollywood help an actress (Kathryn Grayson) get her big break.
programme.title: Anchors Aweigh

programme.desc: Texas wildcatters (Clark Gable, Spencer Tracy) hit oil together, then fight after one marries the other's sweetheart (Claudette Colbert).
programme.title: Boom Town

programme.desc: A fashion photographer (Fred Astaire) turns a Greenwich Village bookworm (Audrey Hepburn) into a Paris cover girl.
programme.title: Funny Face

programme.desc: Corrupt Russian officials mistake a traveling buffoon (Danny Kaye) for the czar's dreaded inspector general.
programme.title: The Inspector General

programme.desc: A shady financier (Orson Welles) pays a man (Robert Arden) to research his past, in order to erase it with murder.
programme.title: Mr. Arkadin

programme.desc: A brother (Fred Astaire) and sister (Jane Powell) take their act to 1947 London. Includes Astaire's famous dance on the ceiling.
programme.title: Royal Wedding

programme.desc: Poor white tenant farmers (Zachary Scott, Betty Field, Beulah Bondi) battle fierce odds to make a living on a Texas plot.
programme.title: The Southerner

programme.desc: The Mexican rebel (Telly Savalas) and his right-hand man (Clint Walker) lead an attack on a U.S. fort.
programme.title: Pancho Villa

programme.desc: The poor orphan niece (Deanna Durbin) of a tycoon (Eugene Pallette) goes to a ball and meets a rich boyfriend (Robert Stack).
programme.title: First Love

programme.desc: A woman (Millie Perkins), two bounty hunters and a gunman (Jack Nicholson) ride into a desert and run out of water.
programme.title: The Shooting

programme.desc: A traveling salesman (Edmond O'Brien) with a wife (Joan Fontaine) in San Francisco marries a waitress (Ida Lupino) in Los Angeles.
programme.title: The Bigamist

programme.desc: The jazz trombonist (James Stewart) marries his sweetheart (June Allyson), forms a band and creates his signature sound.
programme.title: The Glenn Miller Story

programme.desc: A poor but hopeful boy seeks one of the five coveted golden tickets that will send him on a tour of Willy Wonka's mysterious chocolate factory.
programme.title: Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory

programme.desc: One U.S. soldier (Paul Douglas) warns another (Montgomery Clift) about the latter's German girlfriend (Cornell Borchers) during the Berlin airlift.
programme.title: The Big Lift

programme.desc: An English girl's dream of racing her horse in the Grand National thunders to reality with the help of a former jockey.
programme.title: National Velvet

programme.desc: Kirk (William Shatner), Spock (Leonard Nimoy) and the Enterprise crew battle an old foe (Ricardo Montalban) who blames Kirk for the death of his wife.
programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan

programme.desc: A bachelor (Jerry Lewis) agrees to baby-sit for a Hollywood star (Marilyn Maxwell), who turns out to have triplets.
programme.title: Rock-a-Bye Baby

programme.desc: The girl (Glynnis O'Connor) next door makes a teen (John Travolta) born with immune deficiencies want to leave his germ-free bubble.
programme.title: The Boy in the Plastic Bubble

programme.desc: Josephine Marcus (Marie Osmond) falls for the marshal (Bruce Boxleitner) of Tombstone, Ariz., while touring with an opera company.
programme.title: I Married Wyatt Earp

programme.desc: Illinois lawyer Abraham Lincoln (Henry Fonda) becomes known for his honesty and solves a murder with a courtroom trick.
programme.title: Young Mr. Lincoln

programme.desc: A bounty hunter (Glenn Ford) faces his son's killers with help from the son (Michael Burns) of an outlaw he has killed.
programme.title: Santee

programme.desc: Seven children undertake the hazardous 2000-mile journey from Missouri to Oregon in the 1840s after their parents' death.
programme.title: Seven Alone

programme.desc: Stan and Ollie rescue Bo-Peep, Tom-Tom and other Mother Goose characters from Toyland miser Barnaby.
